name: PulseScope
install:
sudo apt-get update
sudo DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends libasound2-dev libssl-dev pkg-config
rustup toolchain install stable --profile minimal -c clippy -c rustfmt
rustup default stable
pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
pnpm build
cargo build --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --no-default-features --features headless,mock-source --bin pulsescope

terminals.name: pulsescope-server
terminals.description: PulseScope headless SDR server (mock IQ source) serving the v2 HTTP/WS API and bundled Svelte UI on http://localhost:8765. Health: GET /health and /health/ready; live spectrum: GET /spectrum; device: GET /device/status.
